Download `UnityTimeTracker.exe` below and run it. Nothing else needs to be installed: the file carries its own .NET runtime.

On first launch it offers to install itself for your Windows user, without admin rights. It goes to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\UnityTimeTracker`, gets a Start menu shortcut, starts with Windows in the tray and shows up in Settings > Apps. Choose "Just run it" to use it without installing. Running a newer exe later offers to update the installed copy and keeps all tracked time.

Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher because the file is not signed. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

To remove it, use Settings > Apps > Installed apps, or the Uninstall button on the app's Settings tab. You can keep or delete your tracked data.
